title: Arithmetic Progression-Free Subset-Sum Sets
summary: For a finite set $A$ of positive integers, let $H(A)$ be its set of subset sums, including the empty sum, and let $g_k(n)$ be the least $N$ for which some $n$-element set $A\subseteq[N]$ has $H(A)$ free of nonconstant $k$-term arithmetic progressions. The problem of determining $g_k(n)$ was posed by Erdős and Sárkőzy. In the three-term case, we prove a lower bound equal to the exact bandwidth of the ternary grid.
